verification.note: Confirmed by reading the code. FileDetailShell.tsx:462-470 handles a raise request with `setSheetState(prev => isSheetExpanded(prev) ? prev : SHEET_STATE_HALF)`. isSheetExpanded (MobileInspectorSheet.tsx:70-71) returns `state !== 'peek'`, so a sheet already at 'full' stays at 'full'. The comment at :460 says this is deliberate. ShellLayout.tsx:436-440 raises the request from `select()` only on mobile. Spec §1 step 7 (document-summary-inspector.md:90-91) and I11 (:330) both say the sheet ends 'at its half snap', with no exception for 'full', so the code departs from the literal spec text. The case can happen in normal use: the full snap is 0.9 (sheetSnap.ts:19), which leaves the top 10% of the viewport uncovered, and the drawer is `modal={false}` (MobileInspectorSheet.tsx:237), so the page chrome above the sheet stays usable. Test gap confirmed: the e2e test at document-summary-inspector.spec.ts:141-152 calls raiseSheet (to half) before startGenerating and asserts a snap fraction of about 0.5, so the full→? path is never exercised. Whether staying at full is the intended reading of 'raises' is a spec-wording question; the code and the invariant as written disagree.

specification_compliance: I11 phone clause: holds from peek and half, not from full (the sheet stays at full).
Spec §1 step 7 says 'raises the sheet to its half snap'; the implementation reads 'raise' as never lowering.
potential_unspecified_behavior: The sheet's state after select() when it starts at full is not covered by I11 as written; the code keeps it at full.
regression_risks: If the spec is changed to match the code instead, the I11 phone test should also start from full to pin the 'stays at full' behaviour.
test_coverage: document-summary-inspector.spec.ts I11 (phone) covers only half→half, not peek→half or full.
No test starts generation with the sheet at full.
not_verified: Did not run the e2e or unit tests; the verification is from static reading only.
